model.model: Division-specific goal/Elo/form with optional dynamic states and temporal calibration

form_model.bootstrap_limit: Resamples classifier fit weights; rolling feature values remain fixed
Resamples classifier fit weights; rolling feature values remain fixed

model.uncertainty: 5-95% week-weight bootstrap spread; conditional sensitivity, not calibrated confidence bounds
model.cold_start_policy: Reject unseen division teams unless explicitly allowed or bridged by configured transfer Elo; neutral goal prior is not calibrated for promotion
limitations: Independent match outcomes conditional on model draw
No lineups, injuries or public betting shares
Optional transfer Elo mixture only when explicitly configured; it does not transfer goal parameters
Optional form classifiers use fixed rolling features during coefficient bootstrap
Dynamic goal states are penalized point estimates, not a full Bayesian posterior
Temporal calibration parameters remain fixed during bootstrap

config.selection_mode: Retrospective fit using only results earlier than selected_before

comparison.method: Normalize inverse odds within bookmaker, then average bookmakers equally
limitations: Margin removal is an approximation; consensus is not ground truth
Market has not been blended into the model or used to select a strategy
Crowd marginal shares do not identify joint column popularity or expected prizes

context: Current match probability benchmark; not an official coupon or pre-close reconstruction of jornada 11
